explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the input as a BODY fragment, then walked tokens with `next_token()`, appending only ordinary `#text` tokens plus opener text from `TITLE` and `TEXTAREA` via `get_modifiable_text()`. I truncated the final UTF-8 string by code points with `mb_strlen()` and `mb_substr()` when available.
